whatThisEditionIs: A metadata-correction tranche. It adds no bytes and retires no asset. Three recorded corrections that Edition 1.2 could not carry are applied, and every other row is inherited unchanged.
grandparentNote: Edition 1.1's published archive container is lost and its content is retained on a verified substitute. See data/record-clearing/master-library/edition-1-1-container-loss-determination.json. Edition 1.3's own parent, Edition 1.2, is retained and its digest verifies exactly.

admittedRows.why: The row encoded a charge extension sheet as a PETITION. A resolver searching for Delaware's Family Court primary filing would reach it, and Form 281 — the actual petition — is unmanifested, so nothing else would stop it. The form-face caption is kept as the official title because it is what the artifact bears; the issuer's own role-bearing index title is recorded alongside rather than replacing it, because replacing either one loses evidence.

The recorded index URL does not resolve and has no archive capture. The replacement is the issuer's live index, confirmed by an official archived capture dated 2026-05-11 and a live read on 2026-08-03. No revision is stamped onto the held bytes: the confirmed index revisions describe what the Commonwealth publishes, not what is retained.

exclusionLogEntry.reason: Fla. R. Crim. P. 3.989 publishes no separate continuation or additional-arrests instrument. The identity was a normalization artefact, not an unacquired source. The prior disposition asserted that a document exists and had merely not been obtained, which is affirmatively wrong and held a release blocker open against a phantom.

admittedRows.why: Recording the negative is the correction. No asset row is added, because there is no asset: the edition gains the finding that this identity names nothing, so no future pass re-queues it for acquisition.

deferredNote: 33 candidates remain in the successor backlog with their exact unmet criteria, including Hawaii's HCJDC 159(b), which is measured exactly but whose bytes are not retrievable in this environment. A row cannot be published into an archive from its measurement alone.
runtimeEffect: none. Every inherited and corrected row keeps generation_allowed = no and runtime_status = runtime_disabled. Publication changes no packet, no route and no gate.
immutabilityRule: Edition 1.2 is opened read-only and copied. It is never edited: a changed archive is a different edition, not a correction.
